What you can do with Lixity

Write and revise manuscripts

Edit your manuscript in the writing workspace. Compare your current draft with the last saved version to see what changed.

Edit a manuscript

Review passages in context

Compare sentence rhythm, word choice and quoted words across chapters. Open the passages behind a measurement to see what Lixity counted.

See a chapter comparisonHow Lixity measures text

From quotation to source

Link sources and character dossiers to passages in the manuscript. Open the saved source version as you read.

Research guide

Share dossiers and reading copies

Export a saved dossier as a PDF with passages and source quotations. You can also make a reading site with selected chapters and background notes.

View Mara’s sample dossier PDF (English)Reading copy (English)

Read aloud and review audio

Record yourself reading in the teleprompter. With a speech service configured, preview one paragraph in the selected voice before rendering a chapter.

Listen to a sample chapterAudio workflow

You decide what to revise

A mark shows what Lixity counted. Read the passage in context and decide if the long sentence or repetition fits the scene.

Frequently asked questions

What does the analysis show?

You can review sentence lengths, recognized quotations and repeated words in the text and compare chapters.

Where are my project files?

Your project files stay on your computer, where the built-in analysis runs. Optional services such as maps and external language models have their own data requirements.

What can I try in the browser?

Use the browser exercise to edit an example paragraph. The read-only Warehouse 4 demo lets you inspect a whole manuscript and its research. Install Lixity to edit, analyse and export your own project.

Try a count for yourself

In one sentence from the demo, Lixity counts 31 words, including 22 function words.

Change a sample paragraph in the browser exercise and see which counts change.

Latest published release · v0.9.3 release notes

Seven interface languages; language-specific analysis

The website and app interface are available in seven languages. Manuscript analysis is separate: English is the default unless you select another profile explicitly, and technical documentation remains in English.

English Deutsch Français Español Italiano Português Nederlands

Language-dependent analysis coverage varies by language and is deepest for German and English. Switching the interface language never alters your manuscript.

Documentation (English)

Technical guides, methods and automation contracts are maintained in English.

Website measurement (English)

This public website uses GoatCounter to count page visits and named demo, installation, repository and PDF links. The adapter sends public page paths and event names, excluding query strings, fragments, form contents and manuscript selections. The local app and exported manuscript reports contain no such measurement.

Language and appearance choices are stored locally in this browser when storage is available. Browser language is used only to suggest a public introduction; it is not sent to a translation service or used to change manuscript analysis.

Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control disable collection. Counts are approximate and do not establish installations or active authors. GoatCounter receives technical request data; see its privacy information. For questions, use the contact below.
